app.title: Race Strategist
app.footer: Data from the challenge API (tech-challenge101.onrender.com). Values are made up for the exercise and do not represent the real performance of drivers or teams.

wake.title: Waking up the server
wake.body: The free API goes to sleep when idle. The first time it can take up to a minute; after that it is fast. No need to reload.

reading.title: Strategy reading
reading.highWear: High wear (×{{value}}): softs wear out fast, consider stopping more or using hards.
reading.lowWear: Low wear (×{{value}}): tyres hold up, one stop is usually enough.
reading.hardOvertaking: Overtaking is almost impossible ({{value}}): track position matters more than fresh tyres.
reading.rain: Rain probability of {{value}}: check the forecast by segment before choosing compounds.
reading.balanced: Balanced circuit: wear and pit loss close to average.

assumptions.title: How it was calculated
assumptions.rain: Rain: if the segment rainIntensity falls outside the compound optimalRainIntensity, it adds (excess × 20 × (1 − wetPerformance)); a wet compound on a dry track adds (shortfall × 6).
assumptions.pit: Pit stop: pitStopLoss {{lane}}s + tyreChangeTime {{change}}s, added on the in lap.
assumptions.unmodeled: Not modelled: safety car ({{safety}} chance), lapTimeVariance {{variance}}s, consistency and traffic (overtakingDifficulty {{overtaking}}). The simulation is deterministic.

pitStops.title: Pit stops
pitStops.none: No pit stops: a single stint from start to finish.
pitStops.note: Each stop = {{lane}}s in the pit lane (pitStopLoss) + {{change}}s tyre change (tyreChangeTime).

chart.title: Lap time
chart.label: Lap time: it rises with wear inside each stint, with rain when the compound is not the right one, and jumps on the pit laps
